content.short: Unmarshal provides granular blockchain data via APIs for developers building dapps.
content.description: Unmarshal delivers granular blockchain data via APIs to speed up dapp development. The platform offers modular products such as DeFi APIs, NFT and Metaverse APIs, notification services, and analytics and insights APIs. By covering multiple networks—Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Fantom, Multichain, Arbitrum, Base, and Polygon zkEVM—it enables developers to access consistent on-chain data across ecosystems, supporting building, indexing, and analysis of diverse applications across multiple use cases.
